close_reason: Duplicate of stoa-2xeks.24 which is already open and tracking REQUIRETLS propagation through SessionState.
description: session.rs SessionState::Mail and SessionState::Rcpt do not carry require_tls. On a TLS session, has_requiretls_param() fires at MAIL FROM and the check passes, but the flag is never stored in state — it is silently dropped. By the time DATA fires, the session has no record that REQUIRETLS was requested, so the outbound RelayEnvelope is built without require_tls=true. RFC 8689 §5 requires the forwarding MTA to propagate REQUIRETLS and enforce it end-to-end; silently dropping it means the server accepts the REQUIRETLS contract from the submitting client but does not honour it downstream.
title: REQUIRETLS flag lost after MAIL FROM — not stored in SessionState
